notes_for_editor: Record name is Kirby Forest; the Forest Lookouts page calls it Hyatt. The only current status is the FFLA list (standing). The Find a Grave memorial (1940-1980) was added by a contributor in February 2026; its citation names Hyatt Cemetery but does not say which record gives the dates. If 1980 is the end of the tower, the FFLA listing is wrong. The Tyler County entry is dated January 1, 1941 but does not name Hyatt, so it is not evidence of the build date. No reliable build date found; the 1943 newspaper item shows only that the tower was in use by then. No access information found, so no access or visit facts are recorded. Two WebSearches used. A site visit or landowner check would settle both status and access.
